title: 惠斯通电桥：把电流表调到零
summary: 两个分压器并排，中点之间接一块电流表；转动电位器让读数归零，就测出了电阻。
description: 惠斯通电桥是精确测电阻的经典方法。+9 V 和 GND 之间并排放两个分压器：左臂 R1（1 kΩ）→ 中点 A → R2（2.2 kΩ）→ GND；右臂 R3（1 kΩ）→ 中点 B → RV1（10 kΩ 电位器当可变电阻）→ GND。电流表 AM1 跨接在 A、B 之间（红表笔接 A）。

cards.title: 找到让表归零的那一点
text: 照目标电路图搭好。然后单击电位器，在「属性」里慢慢拖动旋钮，盯着 AM1：有没有一个位置，读数正好是 0？两边的读数一正一负吗？

cards.title: 平衡 = 两个分压比相同
text: - A、B 两点电位相等时，电流表两端没有电压差，**里面没有电流**。
![](fig:bridge)
- 这要求两个分压器的比例相同：$\frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2} = \frac{R_{V1}}{R_3 + R_{V1}}$，也就是 $\frac{R_2}{R_1} = \frac{R_{V1}}{R_3}$。
- 动手前先算：平衡时 RV1 应是多少？旋钮在百分之几？RV1 比平衡值小或大时，AM1 是正还是负？

cards.title: 调零，再转到两侧
text: - RV1 当可变电阻用：1 脚接 B，滑动端和 3 脚连在一起接 GND，电阻 = 10 kΩ × 旋钮位置。
- 找到读数为零的位置，再分别转到 10% 和 50%，记下读数。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 电桥准，是因为平衡点**只取决于电阻的比值**：和电源电压、电流表准不准都无关，只需要判断“是不是零”。
- 把 R2 换成一个未知电阻，调到平衡，就能算出它的值。电子秤、应变片测力用的也是电桥。
- 测出的电阻只和比较臂的电阻一样准：精密电桥要用精密电阻。

caption.text: 平衡时 A、B 两点电压相同，AM1 里没有电流：这要求 R2 / R1 = R_V1 / R3。

i18n.en: At balance A and B sit at the same voltage and no current flows in AM1: that needs R2 / R1 = R_V1 / R3.

en.startNote: **Half-built**: both dividers of the bridge (R1 + R2, R3 + pot) and the supply are wired. **Why**: dividers were Experiment 1-3; the point of a bridge is the meter between the two midpoints. **Your job**: connect the ammeter between the two midpoints (columns 7 and 12), then turn the pot until it reads zero.
en.title: Wheatstone bridge: null the ammeter
en.summary: Two dividers side by side with an ammeter between their middles; turn the pot until it reads zero and you have measured a resistance.
en.description: The Wheatstone bridge is the classic precise way to measure a resistance. Between +9 V and GND sit two dividers side by side: left arm R1 (1 kΩ) → midpoint A → R2 (2.2 kΩ) → GND; right arm R3 (1 kΩ) → midpoint B → RV1 (a 10 kΩ pot as a variable resistor) → GND. Ammeter AM1 bridges A and B (red probe on A).
en.compare:
**Compare**: balance needs R1 / R2 = R3 / RV1, so RV1 = R3 × R2 / R1 = **2.2kΩ**, i.e. the knob at **22%**. Then V(A) = V(B) = 9 × 2.2 / 3.2 ≈ **6.19 V** and AM1 ≈ 0. Out of balance (simulator readings):
- 10% (RV1 = 1kΩ): the right divider gives less than the left one (without the ammeter B = 4.50 V, A = 6.19 V), so current flows from A to B, AM1 ≈ **+1.42 mA**;
- 50% (RV1 = 5kΩ): the right divider gives more (B = 7.50 V), the current reverses, AM1 ≈ **−0.86 mA**.

Tip: the ammeter is only 0.1Ω, so even out of balance it pulls A and B to almost the same voltage. A multimeter across A and B shows no difference then; watch the ammeter instead.

measurements.ask: Knob at 22% (RV1 = 2.2 kΩ): voltage V_A from A to GND
Knob at 10%: AM1's reading (with its sign)
Knob at 50%: AM1's reading (with its sign)
At 50% the reading is negative. That means:
choices: Current flows from B to A: B is now at a higher potential than A
The ammeter is broken; a negative reading means nothing
Current still flows from A to B, just less than at 10%
measurements.explain: The sign only gives the current's direction relative to the leads (in at red, out at black). Above the balance value RV1 makes the right arm's divider higher, so B sits above A.

hints: Build the two dividers first: R1 + R2 on the left, R3 + RV1 on the right, tops to +9V, bottoms to GND.
RV1 as a variable resistor: pin 1 to B, wiper and pin 3 joined to GND. 22% is 2.2kΩ.
Ammeter red lead at A (between R1 and R2), black lead at B (between R3 and RV1).
tests: RV1 at 10%: current flows from A to B

cards.title: Find the point where the meter reads zero
text: Build it from the target schematic. Then click the pot and slowly drag its knob in Properties, watching AM1: is there a position where it reads exactly 0? Does it read positive on one side and negative on the other?

cards.title: Balance = equal divider ratios
text: - When A and B are at the same potential, the ammeter has no voltage across it and **no current through it**.
![](fig:bridge)
- That needs both dividers to have the same ratio: $\frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2} = \frac{R_{V1}}{R_3 + R_{V1}}$, i.e. $\frac{R_2}{R_1} = \frac{R_{V1}}{R_3}$.
- Work it out before you touch it: what must RV1 be at balance, what percentage is the knob at, and is AM1 positive or negative when RV1 is below or above that?

cards.title: Null it, then turn to either side
text: - RV1 as a variable resistor: pin 1 to B, the wiper and pin 3 joined to GND; resistance = 10 kΩ × knob position.
- Find the zero reading, then turn to 10% and to 50% and note the readings.

cards.title: Take away
text: - A bridge is accurate because the balance point **depends only on resistance ratios**: not on the supply voltage, not on how accurate the ammeter is — you only need to see "zero or not".
- Put an unknown resistor in place of R2, balance the bridge, and you can work out its value. Kitchen scales and strain-gauge force sensors use bridges too.
- The result is only as accurate as the comparison resistors: precision bridges need precision resistors.

tests.name: RV1 在 10%：电流从 A 流向 B

compare:
**对比**：平衡条件 R1 / R2 = R3 / RV1，所以 RV1 = R3 × R2 / R1 = **2.2kΩ**，也就是旋钮在 **22%**。此时 V(A) = V(B) = 9 × 2.2 / 3.2 ≈ **6.19 V**，AM1 ≈ 0。不平衡时（模拟器读数）：
- 10%（RV1 = 1kΩ）：右臂分压比左臂低（不接电流表时 B = 4.50 V，A = 6.19 V），电流从 A 流向 B，AM1 ≈ **+1.42 mA**；
- 50%（RV1 = 5kΩ）：右臂分压比左臂高（B = 7.50 V），电流反过来，AM1 ≈ **−0.86 mA**。

小提示：电流表只有 0.1Ω，不平衡时它也会把 A、B 两点“拉”到几乎同一个电压，所以这时用万用表量 A、B 看不出差别——要看电流表的读数。

measurements.ask: 旋钮在 22%（RV1 = 2.2 kΩ）：A 点对 GND 的电压 V_A
旋钮在 10%：AM1 的读数（带正负号）
旋钮在 50%：AM1 的读数（带正负号）

choices: 电流从 B 流向 A：这时 B 点电位比 A 点高
电流表坏了，负的读数没有意义
电流仍从 A 流向 B，只是比 10% 时小
measurements.explain: 读数的正负只表示电流方向相对于表笔方向（红进黑出）。RV1 大于平衡值时右臂分压比左臂高，B 点电位高于 A 点。

hints: 先搭两个分压器：左边 R1 + R2，右边 R3 + RV1，上端都接 +9V，下端都接 GND。
RV1 当可变电阻：1 脚接 B，滑动端和 3 脚连起来接 GND。旋到 22% 就是 2.2kΩ。
电流表红表笔接 A（R1 和 R2 之间），黑表笔接 B（R3 和 RV1 之间）。
startNote: **半成品**：电桥的两个分压器（R1 + R2，R3 + 电位器）和电源都已搭好。**为什么**：分压器在实验 1-3 练过；电桥的关键是两个中点之间的那块表。**你要做**：把电流表接在两个中点（第 7 列和第 12 列）之间，再转电位器把读数调到零。
